items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source servers. Actively exploited in the wild, it was patched by Adobe on September 7, 2026, with an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146).

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could allow an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without authentication. This vulnerability was part of the APSB26-92 update and has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
